description: What this caller may still do today: its serial lookup allowances and how much of each it has used in the last 24 hours. Macfax is free; the allowances only pace it. Anonymous callers get 5 new serials a day. A key takes an email, starts with 5 and gets 25 once the email is verified, within 200 distinct serials a day. Serials Macfax has already answered, pre-2021 serials and repeats within 24 hours do not count as new. Call this before a large batch of serials to find out whether it can be finished today.
name: get_macfax_limits
title: Check Macfax limits
